If this message doesn't go away, your device has opened a preview that can't run the Academy. This often happens on an iPhone or iPad when you tap an attached file in Mail, Messages or Files, because those previews switch off the page's interactive features.

To use the Academy: open its web link in Safari or Chrome instead. On a computer, you can also download the file and open it in a web browser.

Prototype: you sign in with your claude.ai account, and Academy records are stored online with access rules. See the privacy notice. The full version needs Department-approved hosting and sign-on.
